name: Navbar
purpose: Provides horizontal (or stacked, when narrow) primary navigation with an optional brand region.
scenarios: Site-wide links across the top of a marketing page
Switch application sections from a header
Stack navigation on a compact embedded host

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

items.description: Navigation items with value, label, and optional href.

brand.description: Optional brand or product name region.

activeValue.description: Value of the current page item.

onSelect.description: Called with the item value when a control is activated.

states.name: active
states.description: An item is marked as the current page.

antiPatterns: Do not put the only navigation in a navbar that disappears on compact without an alternative.
Do not use a navbar for sequential wizard progress; use Steps.

keyboard: Tab moves through brand and items
Enter activates the focused link or button
a11y.focus: Items are real links or buttons in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: The nav landmark has an accessible name; current page uses aria-current.

responsive.strategy: Root is a query container. Compact stacks items; tablet/desktop switch the list to a row. No viewport size media.

breakpoints.compact: Brand above a vertical item list; 44px targets.
breakpoints.medium: Horizontal item list at 48rem container width.
breakpoints.large: Wider brand padding and item gap at 80rem container width.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Row direction follows document lang/dir.
